description: Reddit posts (and optionally comments) by keyword, subreddit or user: title, text, author, subreddit, score, links and dates. Good for brand and topic monitoring. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/reddit-monitor on your Apify account (about $0.001 per post or comment; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

include_comments.description: Also return comments of the matched posts (more results, higher cost).

keywords.description: Search all of Reddit; "exact phrase" works.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 500). Cost scales with this.

name: search_reddit

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Search Reddit posts and comments
